forum.title: Can you please tell me which IMU has this top mark: S4 513
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome ​@nenaofdoldrey, to the community!

You asked the [same question on Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/PCB/comments/1u8g0cu/can_someone_help_me_find_accelerometer_on_pcb/), where it has already been answered for you, although not quite completely. The marking **S4** stands for both the [LSM6DSOX](https://www.st.com/en/mems-and-sensors/lsm6dsox.html) (with MCL and other functions) and the [LSM6DSO](https://www.st.com/en/mems-and-sensors/lsm6dsox.html) (without the additional functions).

Hope that helps?

Regards

/Peter
forum.content_text:
The top line is S4 then there is a QR Code and then 513. I think it to be one of the iNEMO Inertial Modules but I don’t know how to go about checking which one. I don’t know the dimension of the package

scraped_replies.html: Thank you so much for your support! I wanted to confirm the writings on Reddit. Is there any reason why the piece I have has 15 pins, and the component product data sheets for both the LSM6DSOX (with MCL and other functions) and the LSM6DSO (without the additional functions) only are said to have 14 pins.
scraped_replies.author: nenaofdoldrey

scraped_replies.html: That is indeed strange and suggests that it may be a different component. However, I am not aware of any with 15 pins in this package.
